name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – Before § 1 – Am 17
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 1d. Stresses that peace and security mean the improvement of wages and pensions, ensuring the public services of healthcare, education and social security provision and the right to housing and the improvement of living conditions, and not the promotion of militarism, arms escalation and war;
